scope: Targeted property tests verifying bidirectional reconciliation morphisms, sealed loss ledgers, target verifier authority gates, and obstruction class certificates under BQNF invariants (Demo 04)

properties_verified.details: All 5 canonical cases from data/cross_domain_reconciliation.json verified. Case 1 (zero obstruction) routes to Preserve ([0], Authorized); Case 2 (exact coboundary defect) routes to Repair ([0], Authorized); Case 3 (unreconciled divergence) routes to Refuse ([NonZero - UnreconciledDiscrepancy], NotAuthorized); Case 4 (missing loss ledger) routes to LossLedgerMissing ([NonZero - MissingLossLedger], NotAuthorized); Case 5 (pending target verifier) routes to AuthorityLaundering (NotAuthorized).

Verified bidirectional exact commute across 50 multi-account transaction graphs: when target state B strictly equals projected source state F(A), the obstruction class is [0] and routes to Preserve with reconciled=True and authorized=True.

Verified coboundary defect exactness across 50 trials: when discrepancy Delta = B - F(A) is matched by verified compensating witnesses d(alpha), the morphism routes to Repair with obstruction [0] and returns compensating cochain payloads.

Verified non-trivial cycle obstruction across 50 trials: unmatched discrepancy defects [Delta] != 0 fail closed to Refuse with obstruction [NonZero - UnreconciledDiscrepancy], reconciled=False, and authorized=False.
Verified that quotient projections omitting or nullifying the LossLedger fail closed to LossLedgerMissing, strictly enforcing that erased attributes must be sealed in a declared ledger.
Verified that target authorization requires an active, successful target verifier. Pending verifier status routes to AuthorityLaundering, and missing or failed verifier routes to MissingVerifier.
